I have found the LRUCache implementation in src/lru.ts. It currently uses a Map to store keys and values and manages recency by deleting and re-adding keys on get or set.

To support TTL:

- We will need to store expiration time per entry.
- Modify storage value from V to an object holding value and expiration timestamp.
- Update get, set, has, size, keys to handle expired items.
- When setting and the capacity is reached, we clean out expired entries first.

Next, I will plan the detailed implementation before making any code changes.
